meta.title: Optimize VSCode extension bundle size by adding .js extensions to core imports
meta.body_summary: Add .js extensions to all core module imports in 24 VSCode extension source files to enable better tree-shaking and smaller bundle size.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added .js extensions to imports for bundle optimization; maintainer closed PR silently within 21 minutes with no review or comments.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 210 changed lines across 24 files, this is a small mechanical change. As a build optimization PR it was closed promptly without merge, suggesting maintainer rejection of the approach or lack of interest.

core_change_summary.description: Across 24 files in packages/vscode/src/, all import paths from ../../core/src/... were appended with .js extension to enforce explicit module resolution for ESBuild bundling.
